annotation.title_clean: On Proactive, Transparent, and Verifiable Ethical Reasoning for Robots
annotation.title_en: On Proactive, Transparent, and Verifiable Ethical Reasoning for Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bremner, P.; Dennis, L.A.; Fisher, M.; Winfield, A.F.
annotation.summary_en: Repository record for a peer-reviewed Proceedings of the IEEE article proposing that ethical machine reasoning for robots be proactive, transparent and verifiable. It presents a separate ethical-layer control architecture using a BDI implementation, logging for transparency and formal verification, demonstrated in a case study.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ethically critical robot reasoning should be proactive, transparent and verifiable.
Proposes a separate ethical layer augmenting layered control architectures, moderating robot actions.
Uses a simulation-based internal model and a Python BDI implementation.
Logging of the reasoning cycle supports transparency; declarative logic supports formal verification.
Claims first robot controller with formally verified ethical reasoning.
